cover_letter:
Dear Common Sense AI team,

I'm writing to apply for the AI Translator role. Your emphasis on making AI work in the real world—translating business challenges into concrete AI opportunities with measurable value—matches the way I approach my work. I use LLMs daily for research, content and audits, and I've built websites with structured data, knowledge-graph markup and llms.txt to improve visibility in AI-powered search. That hands-on experience with Generative AI and data concepts gives me a practical understanding of what AI can and cannot do.

In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I manage CMS content in WordPress and have built and optimized multi-page sites, including one for a Belgian youth chess champion where iterative technical SEO/GEO audits measurably raised the site's search-health score. This work requires listening to client needs, prioritizing actions by impact and feasibility, and explaining technical concepts in plain language—skills that map directly to facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders.

My technical background—Applied Computer Science coursework and front-end development experience—helps me bridge business stakeholders and technical teams. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, and I'm comfortable navigating ambiguous challenges with a pragmatic, analytical mindset focused on business value over technology hype.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help your clients turn AI ambitions into actionable roadmaps and measurable business impact.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
